title: E-SLF-0157: a body-hit on one body changes the field record at a distant body through nothing but the shared mesh...
purpose: Experiment E-SLF-0157 in the selves arena: a body-hit on one body changes the field record at a distant body through nothing but the shared mesh under the committed deterministic rule, the severed-mesh control gives an exact dynamical zero, and the response attenuates with separation, so influence between bodies is carried by the shared medium and only by it.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
